chunks: And concerning a woman who sees in a dream what a man sees, he said: “If she has a discharge, then ghusl (ritual bath) is upon her; and if she does not have a discharge, then there is no ghusl upon her.”

key_terms.غُسْلٌ: ritual bath, here negated when there is no discharge
key_terms.ٱلْغُسْلُ: the ritual bath required after janabah
key_terms.ٱلْمَرْأَةِ: the woman being asked about in the ruling
key_terms.ٱلْمَنَامِ: sleep or dream-state in which the experience occurs

ai.seo_question: Does a woman have to perform ghusl after seeing a sexual dream?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who experiences a sexual dream. It states that ghusl (ritual bath) becomes obligatory only if discharge occurs; otherwise, ghusl is not required.
